translations.web: For Yahweh says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.
translations.bsb: Yes, this is what the LORD says: “A cry of panic is heard— a cry of terror, not of peace.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
translations.asv: For thus saith Jehovah: We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
